'''Zedd Grobbo''' was a muscular [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Moisture farmer/Legends|moisture farmer]] [[Orrin Gault]] and participated in his faked [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] raids in order to coerce other farmers to donate their money for the [[Settlers' Call Fund]].<ref name="Kenobi">[[Kenobi (novel)|''Kenobi'']]</ref>
